notes: `agent_state` (singular GET) is a prin1'd Lisp string — NOT JSON.
`diff` is a prin1'd #S(AUTOPOIESIS.CORE:SEXPR-EDIT ...) struct list — NOT JSON.
Frontend should consume `/diff-magnitude/` (added for AETHER) instead of `/diff/`.
`metadata` is a JSON array encoding a Lisp plist: [k1, v1, k2, v2, ...].
`metadata[1]` is the lineage name; `metadata[3]` is the mood keyword (e.g. "linear").
`parent` is null on root snapshots, otherwise a snapshot UUID string.
